name: The Witches Saga: My Dahlia
source:
You said I was just like a dahlia.

Pure. Beautiful. Kind.

And that you loved that kind of me.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/my-dahlia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你曾说，我就像一朵大丽花。

纯洁，美丽，善良。

还说，你深爱着那样的我。

[摘自[url=https://altila.itch.io/my-dahlia]itch.io[/url]]
